description: Report the expiry of the CA certificate bundle, the CRLs, the server's own certificate, and the certificates the CA has issued, on the CA host. Read-only.

warn_days.description: Flag anything that expires within this many days.

issued.description: Which issued certificates from the CA's signed directory to list: only those due within warn_days or already expired, all of them, or none. Counts for the whole directory are always returned.

section.description: The puppet.conf section to resolve settings from.
